flow: transmute kafka-consumer-hook -> loadMaster by binding id on systemDB
claim: loadMaster runs a single-row lookup on systemDB filtered by mb.id and wraps any database error with the prefix master lookup by id.

flow: pgx v5 ParseConfig default exec mode
claim: pgx v5.9.1 ParseConfig sets the default query exec mode to QueryExecModeCacheStatement unless default_query_exec_mode is provided in the connection string.

flow: pgx v5 ParseConfig statement cache capacity
claim: pgx v5.9.1 ParseConfig uses a default statement cache capacity of 512 statements per connection.
Registry.openPgx sets pgxpool MaxConns from DBPool.MaxOpenConn and MinConns from DBPool.MaxIdleConn.
The transmute batch upsert builds a multi-row VALUES statement whose placeholder count is rows times keys, so the SQL text changes with batch row count.
isRetryableDBError treats every PostgreSQL SQLSTATE starting with 53 as retryable.
isRetryableDBError treats SQLSTATE 53200 out of memory as a permanent error and returns false.
loadMaster queries the shadow database directly through shadowDB when looking up a master binding by id.
